div.div: one flow for every kind of source
graph data plus the source links
The ontology, the brand's lines and occasions, and the paired text or photo.
The same call as tab 1, once per source.
Only kinds, values and parts the ontology has become graph data; the rest is reported.
4 Write graph data and the sources
Each look, its garments, its occasion, and a link to the photo or text it came from.
Graph data and embeddings sit side by side in one graph, so a similarity search and a graph walk use the same store.
